note: Generated from passages retrieved from the design document, then checked against those same passages by the lore critic. Corrections and the drafts they replaced are in critique/critique_log.json.

landed.title: LANDED
landed.cause: Ship down, staged, and crewed. The haul auto-sold where you came down, minus the tow fee if that was away from the yard.
landed.rule_broken: A run ends when the ship is staged, grounded, and crewed — the haul auto-sells and the turnaround begins.
landed.armstrong: Wheels down and the scale's honest. Turnaround's on the clock, kid.

refused.detector: a module delivered in scrap state
refused.title: REFUSED
refused.cause: The module was delivered in scrap state. Delivery was refused, and the drones returned it to orbit for a re-fly.
refused.rule_broken: A scrap-state module delivery resolves to refused — a loss, never a win; scrap never wins the run.
refused.armstrong: Scrap. You hauled me back scrap, kid. She goes up again and you don't bring her down like that twice.

zero_hp.detector: ship destroyed on a hard landing, or by reentering too hot
zero_hp.title: SHIP DESTROYED
zero_hp.cause: The ship is gone — a hard landing, or a reentry hot enough to pin the bar and burn through plate, then cargo, then hull.
zero_hp.rule_broken: Heat spends shield plate first, cargo second, hull last; landings are graded on vertical speed, soft under about 5 m/s.
zero_hp.armstrong: She's scrap now, kid. Pad's clear — cash and upgrades keep.

burned_up.detector: astronaut on EVA in atmosphere above the heat-speed threshold
burned_up.title: BURNED UP
burned_up.cause: The astronaut was outside, in atmosphere, above the heat-speed threshold.
burned_up.rule_broken: The suit carries no heat protection — fuel is no defense, and F is inert once heat builds.
burned_up.armstrong: Suit's not a shield, kid. Never was.

stranded.detector: the run can no longer reach a landing and no recovery input remains
stranded.title: STRANDED
stranded.cause: The run could no longer reach a landing and no recovery input remained. The check fired and called it here.
stranded.rule_broken: One unwinnability check fires when no landing remains and no input recovers it; warp is disabled the instant it arms.
stranded.armstrong: Nothing left to fly out of that one, kid. Pad's waiting.

stranded_a.detector: ship undeorbitable — out of fuel, or staged so the tank is gone — on an arc whose periapsis never enters the atmosphere
stranded_a.title: STRANDED
stranded_a.cause: The ship cannot deorbit — out of fuel, or staged so the tank is gone — on an arc whose periapsis never enters the atmosphere.
stranded_a.rule_broken: Staging is one-way and kills all thrust, and an arc whose periapsis never enters the atmosphere never comes down.
stranded_a.armstrong: No tank, no burn, no down. That's the arithmetic, kid.

stranded_b.detector: astronaut jetpack-dry beyond tether reach of the ship
stranded_b.title: STRANDED
stranded_b.cause: The jetpack ran dry with the astronaut beyond tether reach of the ship.
stranded_b.rule_broken: The magnet grips the hull, so a dry jetpack inside tether range is only an inconvenience — outside it, nothing to winch.
stranded_b.armstrong: RETURN lamp goes red, you let the piece go. Every time, kid.

stranded_c.detector: astronaut touching terrain while not aboard the ship
stranded_c.title: STRANDED
stranded_c.cause: The astronaut touched terrain while not aboard the ship. How you got there does not change it — a slow fall that never got hot, or a step away from a hull parked on the ground. Landed needs the pilot aboard.
stranded_c.rule_broken: Landed requires the astronaut aboard — touching terrain while not aboard the ship is stranded, not a landing.
stranded_c.armstrong: Standing in the dirt without her is still standing in the dirt, kid.

stranded_d.detector: ship staged, chute shredded, on a descent whose minimum achievable touchdown speed exceeds the destruction cap
stranded_d.title: SHIP DESTROYED
stranded_d.cause: Staged, chute shredded, and the lowest touchdown speed still reachable was past the destruction cap. The check called it there rather than making you fly the fall out.
stranded_d.rule_broken: A parachute deployed during plasma shreds; a conservative closed-form check resolves the doomed descent as 0 HP at once.
stranded_d.armstrong: Canopy's gone, kid. Wasn't coming down soft after that.
